description: Create an unpublished draft rental listing owned by the signed-in person. Returns a URL where they finish and publish it in the browser. Publishing is never done here: the owner reviews each step, sets a monthly rent above $0 and agrees to the listing terms themselves, and the address must be in a market A-du serves (Los Angeles County, San Francisco, San Diego County or New York City). Photos, identity verification and bank details are not required to publish.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying so a dropped response cannot create a second request.

name.description: A short title, such as "Garden studio near Leimert Park". Defaults to "ADU in <city>". Never the street address: titles are public and A-du does not publish addresses.

name: draft_listing
title: Draft a rental listing
